prompts.pat: Create one transparent 4 by 2 grid sprite atlas of EXACTLY the same chibi blue-haired whale maid girl from the reference, each full-body cell evenly spaced. Eight sequential strong head pat reaction poses, left-right top-bottom: neutral; start tilting head; tilt further; eyes softly close; deeply pleased leaning head, blush; easing back; near upright; reference neutral. She keeps holding blue whale plush. Maintain identical character identity, outfit, cell scale and shoe baseline. Distinct expressive poses, 2-3 times larger head movement than a tiny idle variation. Genuine alpha transparency, no lines or labels between cells, no text, no extra hands, no cropped body.
prompts.celebrate: Produce a production sprite atlas on a truly transparent canvas (alpha zero everywhere outside character silhouettes). No colored or blurred background at all. Exact four columns by two rows, eight independent full-body drawings, equal cell size, large transparent spacing. Same chibi blue-haired whale girl maid and blue whale plush as supplied idle image. Animate a clear task-completion celebration left-to-right then next row: 1 neutral holding plush chest, 2 crouch slightly, 3 lift plush to shoulder, 4 lift plush above head with both arms and closed joyful eyes, 5 hop with one foot raised and plush above head, 6 descend, 7 lower plush, 8 neutral holding plush chest. Same costume, hair, tail, eyes, lineart, framing and body size in every cell. Fixed baseline for standing shoes; the raised foot in hop is intentional. No floor shadow, environment, gradient, grid line, text, watermark, duplicate appendages or cropped body. Transparent PNG atlas.
prompts.concern: Production sprite atlas, truly transparent alpha-zero background. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight separate full-body cells in reading order, same chibi blue-haired whale maid girl with the same small blue whale plush from reference. Depict a clear urgent-task concern reaction: neutral -> head/eyes turn to notice -> worried raised inner eyebrows -> small frown and hug plush tighter -> peak shoulders curled forward, eyebrows knitted and mouth worried -> ease back -> soften face -> neutral. Preserve identical identity, outfit, hair, whale tail, body scale, shoe baseline, camera angle, full body and isolated transparent cell spacing. Expression must read as concerned rather than smiling or surprised. NO floating symbols, emoji, flowers, exclamation marks, signs, text, background, shadow, decorative effects, duplicate limbs or cropping.
prompts.idle-look: Transparent 4 columns by 2 rows atlas of eight sequential full-body animation poses, one cute chibi whale-girl maid per cell, same exact character and blue plush as supplied idle sprite. This is a clear but gentle idle glance and tail sway: 1 neutral reference look, 2 eyes look left, 3 turn and tilt head left noticeably and tail swishes right, 4 curious bright eyes holding tilt, 5 eyes blink while tilted, 6 head turns right and tail swishes left, 7 looks toward viewer, 8 returns to exact neutral. Same figure size and shoe baseline in every cell, full body never cropped, transparent gaps between cells. Preserve blue hair, maid headband, navy dress, plush, tail, outlines. Make pose differences readable at a 240px pet size without moving her whole body. Absolutely no background or shadow, grid lines, letters, captions, watermark, extra characters or appendages. Alpha zero outside figure silhouettes.
